title: Airtable create or update with more than 10 records fails with 422
symptoms: 422 when the records array holds 11 or more items
table.create(orders) in airtable.js works for small orders and fails for large ones
No partial write: none of the records are created
cause: Create, update and delete calls accept at most 10 records per request. airtable.js passes the whole array through without splitting it.
fix: Chunk record arrays into groups of 10 and send them in sequence to stay inside the per-base rate limit.
affected: Airtable Web API and airtable.js 0.12.x, as of 2026-10
